title: Austin Music Festival 2026
description: Three days of live music across 8 stages featuring over 150 artists from around the world. Food vendors, art installations, and after-parties included.

title: DevConnect Conference
description: The premier developer conference for full-stack engineers. Keynotes, workshops, and networking with industry leaders in AI, cloud, and web technologies.
address: 500 E Cesar Chavez St, Austin, TX 78701

title: Farm-to-Table Food Festival
description: Celebrate local cuisine with 40+ vendors showcasing organic, farm-fresh dishes. Live cooking demos, wine pairings, and a sustainable food panel.

title: Spring Marathon & Half-Marathon
description: Annual spring running event through scenic Austin trails. Full marathon, half-marathon, and 5K options. Chip-timed with post-race celebration.

title: Contemporary Art Exhibition
description: A curated exhibition featuring 25 emerging artists exploring themes of technology and nature. Opening night reception with artist talks and live music.

title: Startup Pitch Night
description: Watch 10 early-stage startups pitch to a panel of VCs and angel investors. Network with founders, investors, and tech professionals over drinks and appetizers.

title: Jazz Under the Stars
description: An intimate evening of world-class jazz in an outdoor amphitheater. Featuring the Marcus Bell Quartet with special guest vocalist Nina Torres.
address: 1500 E MLK Jr Blvd, Austin, TX 78702

title: AI & Machine Learning Summit
description: Deep-dive into the latest advances in AI, LLMs, and machine learning. Hands-on workshops, research presentations, and an AI art gallery.

title: Craft Beer & BBQ Festival
description: Sample over 100 craft beers from 30 local breweries paired with championship BBQ. Live country music, lawn games, and a homebrew competition.
address: 2101 Jesse E Segovia St, Austin, TX 78702

title: Youth Soccer Tournament
description: Regional youth soccer tournament for ages 8-18. Over 60 teams competing across 4 divisions. Medals, trophies, and college scout attendance.
address: 7301 Circle C Ranch Trail, Austin, TX 78749

title: Leadership & Innovation Workshop
description: A full-day interactive workshop on leadership in the age of AI. Exercises in design thinking, team dynamics, and strategic decision-making.

title: Improv Comedy Night
description: A hilarious evening of long-form and short-form improv comedy by Austin's top troupes. Audience participation encouraged. BYOB-friendly venue.
